script_text: Aquarius, this week the cosmos charges your air sign with sudden, electric shifts that demand your utmost adaptability. Early on, Mercury in your 10th House of career squares Mars in the 7th House of partners, creating friction in professional collaborations and personal relationships. Monday and Tuesday will feel tense, so choose your words carefully during negotiations. The mid-week turning point arrives as Venus trines Saturn in your 11th House, stabilizing your social circle and bringing unexpected support. By late week, the Sun enters your 9th House of expansion, illuminating your long-term vision and bringing exciting intellectual breakthroughs, especially regarding love and career advancements. Wednesday is your best day because Venus trine Saturn opens doors for romance. Tuesday is your worst day due to the Mercury-Mars square sparking arguments. Trust your air element's adaptability and focus on long-term goals. Follow for daily updates.
